ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.

17. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

19. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

21. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
